scenes.title: Into the Event Horizon
scenes.source:
# DynLex entrypoint flags: --emit-spirv --shader-stage=fragment

import lib/shader_art.dl

# EVENT HORIZON
# A camera falls through a continuously warped star field toward a rotating
# black hole. No spatial lattice is used anywhere in the image.

class:
    patterns:
        planar coordinate
    members:
        x, y

class:
    patterns:
        radiant color
    members:
        red, green, blue

function a planar coordinate with x {float:x} and y {float:y}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", planar coordinate, x, y)

function a radiant color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", radiant color, red, green, blue)

function a moving star field at {planar coordinate:position} scaled by {float:scale} during {float:phase} at {float:time}:
    execute:
        set depth to the fractional part of ((time * 0.13) + phase)
        set expansion to 0.42 + ((depth * depth) * 3.6)
        set sample to a planar coordinate with x (((position's x) / expansion) * scale) and y (((position's y) / expansion) * scale)
        set points to the spark field at (a shader point with x sample's x and y sample's y) during (phase * 13.7)
        set horizontal to the spark field at (a shader point with x (sample's x * 0.33) and y sample's y) during ((phase * 13.7) + 0.09)
        set vertical to the spark field at (a shader point with x sample's x and y (sample's y * 0.33)) during ((phase * 13.7) - 0.11)
        set radius to the square root of ((position's x * position's x) + (position's y * position's y))
        set streaks to (horizontal + vertical) * (the glow from 0.0 to 1.35 at radius)
        set twinkle to ((the sine of ((time * 2.7) + (phase * 29.0))) * 0.13) + 0.87
        return (((points * 2.8) + (streaks * 0.17)) * (0.28 + (depth * 1.25))) * twinkle

set pixel to a planar coordinate with x the fragment x coordinate and y the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set frame to a planar coordinate with x (the maximum of (the shader width) and 1.0) and y (the maximum of (the shader height) and 1.0)
set aspect to frame's x / frame's y
set screen to a planar coordinate with x (((pixel's x / (frame's x)) * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect) and y ((pixel's y / (frame's y)) * 2.0 - 1.0)

# The fall accelerates and drifts, making the horizon consume the camera.
set flight to (0.62 + (time * 0.055)) + ((time * time) * 0.0018)
set drift to a planar coordinate with x ((the sine of (time * 0.27)) * 0.048) and y ((the cosine of (time * 0.21)) * 0.026)
set position to a planar coordinate with x ((screen's x + drift's x) / flight) and y ((screen's y + drift's y) / flight)
set radius to the square root of ((position's x * position's x) + (position's y * position's y))
set denominator to the maximum of radius and 0.001

# Gravitational lensing twists and magnifies the universe around the shadow.
set angle to (0.19 / ((radius * radius) + 0.021)) + (time * 0.035)
set angle to the minimum of angle and 4.6
set sine to the sine of angle
set cosine to the cosine of angle
set scale to 1.0 + (0.12 / ((radius * radius) + 0.012))
set universe to a planar coordinate with x (((position's x * cosine) - (position's y * sine)) * scale) and y (((position's x * sine) + (position's y * cosine)) * scale)

# A continuous domain-warped nebula replaces the old square value-noise field.
set primary to the flowing field at (a shader point with x ((universe's x * 1.8) + (time * 0.025)) and y ((universe's y * 1.8) - 4.0)) during 1.7
set secondary to the flowing field at (a shader point with x ((universe's x * 4.6) - 11.0) and y ((universe's y * 4.6) + (time * 0.018))) during 5.3
set ridge to the ridged field at (a shader point with x ((universe's x * 2.4) + 7.0) and y ((universe's y * 2.4) - 9.0)) during (time * 0.045)
set phase to ((universe's x * 2.7) - (universe's y * 3.6)) + (primary * 8.0)
set aurora to ((the sine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5
set cloud to the smooth transition from 0.45 to 0.86 at primary
set dust to the smooth transition from 0.52 to 0.90 at secondary
set color to a radiant color with red ((0.002 + (cloud * 0.022)) + ((ridge * aurora) * 0.075)), green ((0.004 + (cloud * 0.028)) + ((dust * aurora) * 0.052)) and blue ((0.014 + (cloud * 0.13)) + ((dust * (1.0 - aurora)) * 0.24))

# Three curved depth strata stream past the lens.
set faraway to a moving star field at universe scaled by 13.0 during 0.09 at time
set middle to a moving star field at universe scaled by 21.0 during 0.41 at time
set nearby to a moving star field at universe scaled by 31.0 during 0.77 at time
set stars to ((faraway * 0.46) + (middle * 0.76)) + (nearby * 1.14)
set temperature to the flowing field at (a shader point with x (universe's x * 5.1) and y (universe's y * 5.1)) during 8.2
set color's red to color's red + (stars * (0.58 + (temperature * 0.62)))
set color's green to color's green + (stars * (0.70 + (temperature * 0.31)))
set color's blue to color's blue + (stars * (1.25 - (temperature * 0.18)))

# A dense, tilted accretion flow. Continuous curl controls every filament.
set tilt to 0.12 + ((the sine of (time * 0.17)) * 0.018)
set sine to the sine of tilt
set cosine to the cosine of tilt
set disk to a planar coordinate with x ((position's x * cosine) + (position's y * sine)) and y ((position's y * cosine) - (position's x * sine))
set stretched to disk's y * 7.2
set orbit to the square root of ((disk's x * disk's x) + (stretched * stretched))
set inner to the smooth transition from 0.23 to 0.285 at orbit
set outer to 1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.72 to 1.12 at orbit
set mask to inner * outer
set turbulence to the signed flow at (a shader point with x ((disk's x * 8.3) + (time * 0.52)) and y (stretched * 1.8)) during 3.1
set detail to the signed flow at (a shader point with x ((disk's x * 18.0) - (time * 0.91)) and y (stretched * 3.7)) during 7.9
set phase to (((orbit * 39.0) - (time * 6.8)) + (turbulence * 7.4)) + (detail * 2.2)
set spiral to ((the sine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5
set phase to ((orbit * 71.0) - (time * 10.4)) - (turbulence * 4.0)
set braid to ((the cosine of phase) * 0.5) + 0.5
set heat to 1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.29 to 0.83 at orbit
set energy to (mask * ((0.19 + (spiral * 0.58)) + (braid * 0.23))) * (0.55 + (heat * 4.4))
set approaching to (((disk's x / (the maximum of orbit and 0.001)) * 0.5) + 0.5) saturated
set color's red to color's red + (energy * (1.72 - (approaching * 0.62)))
set color's green to color's green + (energy * (0.30 + (approaching * 1.04)))
set color's blue to color's blue + (energy * (0.055 + (approaching * 2.18)))

# Relativistic jets become visible close to the poles.
set axis to the absolute value of (position's x)
set core to the glow from 0.0 to 0.032 at axis
set halo to the glow from 0.018 to 0.16 at axis
set reach to the smooth transition from 0.19 to 0.72 at (the absolute value of (position's y))
set flicker to the flowing field at (a shader point with x (position's x * 15.0) and y ((position's y * 3.0) - (time * 0.8))) during 10.0
set jet to (((core * 0.52) + (halo * 0.13)) * reach) * (0.35 + (flicker * 0.65))
set color's red to color's red + (jet * 0.21)
set color's green to color's green + (jet * 0.48)
set color's blue to color's blue + (jet * 1.36)

# The shadow erases the far universe. The near side of the disk remains.
set horizon to 1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.176 to 0.202 at radius
set color's red to color's red * (1.0 - horizon)
set color's green to color's green * (1.0 - horizon)
set color's blue to color's blue * (1.0 - horizon)
set front to 1.0 - the smooth transition from -0.019 to 0.015 at disk's y
set foreground to energy * front
set color's red to color's red + (foreground * (1.61 - (approaching * 0.48)))
set color's green to color's green + (foreground * (0.34 + (approaching * 0.93)))
set color's blue to color's blue + (foreground * (0.07 + (approaching * 1.94)))

# Light wraps around both poles into a sharp photon ring.
set distance to the absolute value of (radius - 0.216)
set ring to the glow from 0.001 to 0.017 at distance
set poles to the absolute value of (position's y / denominator)
set arcs to ring * (the smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.86 at poles)
set flicker to ((the sine of ((time * 2.1) + (turbulence * 5.0))) * 0.10) + 0.90
set color's red to (color's red + ((ring * 1.34) * flicker)) + (arcs * 2.2)
set color's green to (color's green + ((ring * 0.72) * flicker)) + (arcs * 0.93)
set color's blue to (color's blue + ((ring * 0.44) * flicker)) + (arcs * 1.48)

# Filmic compression without a raster film: the browser shades every pixel.
set gap to the absolute value of (radius - 0.202)
set halo to (0.04 / (gap + 0.04)) * (1.0 - horizon)
set color's red to color's red + (halo * 0.19)
set color's green to color's green + (halo * 0.07)
set color's blue to color's blue + (halo * 0.31)
set edge to the square root of (((screen's x / aspect) * (screen's x / aspect)) + (screen's y * screen's y))
set vignette to 0.18 + ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.48 to 1.34 at edge) * 0.82)
set color's red to the square root of ((color's red * vignette) / (1.0 + color's red))
set color's green to the square root of ((color's green * vignette) / (1.0 + color's green))
set color's blue to the square root of ((color's blue * vignette) / (1.0 + color's blue))
set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0

scenes.title: Endless Terrain
scenes.source:
# DynLex entrypoint flags: --emit-spirv --shader-stage=fragment

import lib/shader_art.dl

# ENDLESS TERRAIN
# The surface is a procedural height field intersected by every camera ray.
# Elevation therefore changes silhouette, perspective, normals, and light.

class:
    patterns:
        terrain coordinate
    members:
        x, z

class:
    patterns:
        spatial coordinate
    members:
        x, y, z

class:
    patterns:
        terrain color
    members:
        red, green, blue

class:
    patterns:
        terrain traversal
    members:
        hit, searching, travel, previous, distance, step

function a terrain coordinate with x {float:x} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", terrain coordinate, x, z)

function a spatial coordinate with x {float:x}, y {float:y} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", spatial coordinate, x, y, z)

function a terrain color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", terrain color, red, green, blue)

function a terrain traversal beginning at {float:distance}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", terrain traversal, false, true, distance, distance, distance, 0)

function {terrain traversal:traversal} continues searching:
    execute:
        return traversal's searching

function {terrain traversal:traversal} found terrain:
    execute:
        return traversal's hit

function the terrain height at {terrain coordinate:position}:
    execute:
        set warp to a terrain coordinate with x ((the sine of ((position's x * 0.083) + (position's z * 0.047))) + ((the cosine of ((position's x * -0.031) + (position's z * 0.071))) * 0.53)) and z ((the cosine of ((position's x * -0.057) + (position's z * 0.061))) + ((the sine of ((position's x * 0.069) + (position's z * 0.029))) * 0.47))
        set bent to a terrain coordinate with x (position's x + (warp's x * 3.4)) and z (position's z + (warp's z * 3.4))
        set continental to (the sine of ((bent's x * 0.073) + (bent's z * 0.051))) * 0.62
        set crossing to (the cosine of ((bent's x * -0.049) + (bent's z * 0.091))) * 0.34
        set ridge to ((the cosine of (((bent's x * 0.17) - (bent's z * 0.11)) + (warp's z * 0.31))) * 0.5) + 0.5
        set spur to ((the cosine of (((bent's x * -0.13) - (bent's z * 0.23)) - (warp's x * 0.27))) * 0.5) + 0.5
        set crest to ((the cosine of (((bent's x * 0.29) + (bent's z * 0.07)) + (warp's z * 0.19))) * 0.5) + 0.5
        set ridge to (ridge * ridge) * (ridge * ridge)
        set spur to (spur * spur) * (spur * spur)
        set crest to (crest * crest) * (crest * crest)
        set peaks to ((ridge * 2.08) + (spur * 1.46)) + (crest * 0.92)
        set mask to the smooth transition from -0.46 to 0.54 at (continental + crossing)
        set elevation to peaks * (0.31 + (mask * 0.78))
        set detail to ((the sine of ((bent's x * 0.51) + (bent's z * 0.37))) * 0.10) + ((the cosine of ((bent's x * -0.83) + (bent's z * 0.61))) * 0.045)
        return (((-0.31 + continental) + (crossing * 0.54)) + elevation) + detail

set pixel to a terrain coordinate with x the fragment x coordinate and z the fragment y coordinate
set time to the shader time
set frame to a terrain coordinate with x (the maximum of (the shader width) and 1.0) and z (the maximum of (the shader height) and 1.0)
set aspect to frame's x / frame's z
set screen to a terrain coordinate with x (((pixel's x / (frame's x)) * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect) and z ((pixel's z / (frame's z)) * 2.0 - 1.0)

# The camera glides above intersecting ranges instead of following a valley.
set camera to a spatial coordinate with x (((the sine of (time * 0.13)) * 3.1) + ((the cosine of (time * 0.071)) * 1.4)), y (3.26 + ((the sine of (time * 0.19)) * 0.13)) and z (76.0 + (time * 3.05))
set yaw to ((the sine of (time * 0.097)) * 0.16) + ((the cosine of (time * 0.061)) * 0.07)
set sine to the sine of yaw
set cosine to the cosine of yaw
set bank to (the sine of (time * 0.19)) * 0.025
set tilt to a terrain coordinate with x ((screen's x * (the cosine of bank)) - (screen's z * (the sine of bank))) and z ((screen's x * (the sine of bank)) + (screen's z * (the cosine of bank)))
set direction to a spatial coordinate with x (((tilt's x * 0.68) * cosine) + (1.24 * sine)), y ((tilt's z * 0.68) - 0.19) and z ((1.24 * cosine) - ((tilt's x * 0.68) * sine))
set length to the square root of (((direction's x * direction's x) + (direction's y * direction's y)) + (direction's z * direction's z))
set direction's x to direction's x / length
set direction's y to direction's y / length
set direction's z to direction's z / length

# Dawn sky and curved clouds are evaluated independently from the terrain.
set altitude to ((screen's z * 0.54) + 0.45) saturated
set color to a terrain color with red (0.018 + (altitude * 0.075)), green (0.052 + (altitude * 0.16)) and blue (0.12 + (altitude * 0.34))
set sweep to the flowing field at (a shader point with x ((screen's x * 1.25) + (time * 0.018)) and y ((screen's z * 2.4) + 3.0)) during 2.1
set ridges to the ridged field at (a shader point with x ((screen's x * 2.1) - 8.0) and y ((screen's z * 3.7) + (time * 0.012))) during 5.7
set shape to the smooth transition from 0.54 to 0.82 at ((sweep * 0.76) + (ridges * 0.24))
set elevation to the smooth transition from -0.05 to 0.31 at screen's z
set cloud to shape * elevation
set color's red to color's red + (cloud * 0.34)
set color's green to color's green + (cloud * 0.31)
set color's blue to color's blue + (cloud * 0.27)
set sun to a terrain coordinate with x (screen's x - 0.56) and z (screen's z - 0.39)
set distance to the square root of ((sun's x * sun's x) + (sun's z * sun's z))
set core to the glow from 0.018 to 0.075 at distance
set halo to the glow from 0.06 to 0.42 at distance
set color's red to (color's red + (halo * 0.27)) + (core * 1.3)
set color's green to (color's green + (halo * 0.16)) + (core * 0.92)
set color's blue to (color's blue + (halo * 0.08)) + (core * 0.52)

# Uniform height-field traversal covers the complete view depth for every ray.
# The previous and current samples bracket the first surface crossing, then six
# refinements recover a stable sharp surface.
set traversal to a terrain traversal beginning at 0.12
set sample to camera
set height to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x sample's x and z sample's z)
while traversal's step < 96 and traversal continues searching:
    set sample's x to camera's x + (direction's x * traversal's travel)
    set sample's y to camera's y + (direction's y * traversal's travel)
    set sample's z to camera's z + (direction's z * traversal's travel)
    set height to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x sample's x and z sample's z)
    if sample's y < height:
        set traversal's hit to true
        set traversal's searching to false
        set traversal's distance to traversal's travel
    else:
        set traversal's previous to traversal's travel
        set traversal's travel to traversal's travel + 0.46
        if traversal's travel > 44.0:
            set traversal's step to 96
            set traversal's searching to false
    increment traversal's step

set refinement to 0
while refinement < 6 and traversal found terrain:
    set middle to (traversal's previous + traversal's distance) * 0.5
    set sample to a spatial coordinate with x (camera's x + (direction's x * middle)), y (camera's y + (direction's y * middle)) and z (camera's z + (direction's z * middle))
    set height to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x sample's x and z sample's z)
    if sample's y < height:
        set traversal's distance to middle
    else:
        set traversal's previous to middle
    increment refinement

if traversal found terrain:
    set world to a spatial coordinate with x (camera's x + (direction's x * traversal's distance)), y (camera's y + (direction's y * traversal's distance)) and z (camera's z + (direction's z * traversal's distance))
    set height to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x world's x and z world's z)

    # Finite differences turn real elevation into real surface light.
    set stride to 0.055 + (traversal's distance * 0.0018)
    set west to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x (world's x - stride) and z world's z)
    set east to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x (world's x + stride) and z world's z)
    set south to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x world's x and z (world's z - stride))
    set north to the terrain height at (a terrain coordinate with x world's x and z (world's z + stride))
    set normal to a spatial coordinate with x (west - east), y (stride * 2.0) and z (south - north)
    set length to the square root of (((normal's x * normal's x) + (normal's y * normal's y)) + (normal's z * normal's z))
    set normal's x to normal's x / length
    set normal's y to normal's y / length
    set normal's z to normal's z / length

    set sunlight to (((normal's x * 0.48) + (normal's y * 0.76)) - (normal's z * 0.44)) saturated
    set skylight to ((normal's y * 0.5) + 0.5) saturated
    set material to the flowing field at (a shader point with x (world's x * 0.72) and y (world's z * 0.72)) during 9.4
    set detail to the ridged field at (a shader point with x ((world's x * 1.91) + 4.0) and y ((world's z * 1.91) - 7.0)) during 3.8
    set mineral to the flowing field at (a shader point with x ((world's x * 3.4) - 9.0) and y ((world's z * 3.4) + 2.0)) during 6.1
    set exposure to the smooth transition from 0.16 to 0.61 at (1.0 - normal's y)
    set snow to the smooth transition from 1.48 to 2.28 at height
    set ground to a terrain color with red ((0.018 + (material * 0.047)) + (detail * 0.021)), green ((0.075 + (material * 0.15)) + (detail * 0.052)) and blue ((0.052 + (material * 0.083)) + (detail * 0.039))
    set rock to a terrain color with red ((0.115 + (material * 0.11)) + (mineral * 0.087)), green ((0.098 + (material * 0.075)) + (mineral * 0.061)) and blue ((0.105 + (material * 0.095)) + (mineral * 0.073))
    set ground's red to (ground's red * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's red * exposure)
    set ground's green to (ground's green * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's green * exposure)
    set ground's blue to (ground's blue * (1.0 - exposure)) + (rock's blue * exposure)
    set ground's red to (ground's red * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.78 * snow)
    set ground's green to (ground's green * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.84 * snow)
    set ground's blue to (ground's blue * (1.0 - snow)) + (0.89 * snow)
    set lighting to (0.11 + (sunlight * 1.13)) + (skylight * 0.16)
    set ground's red to (ground's red * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.24)
    set ground's green to (ground's green * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.17)
    set ground's blue to (ground's blue * lighting) + (sunlight * 0.09)

    # Atmospheric perspective reveals depth without drawing a path or band.
    set fog to the smooth transition from 11.0 to 41.0 at traversal's distance
    set atmosphere to a terrain color with red (0.19 + (halo * 0.16)), green (0.25 + (halo * 0.10)) and blue (0.31 + (halo * 0.05))
    set color's red to (ground's red * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's red * fog)
    set color's green to (ground's green * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's green * fog)
    set color's blue to (ground's blue * (1.0 - fog)) + (atmosphere's blue * fog)

set edge to the square root of (((screen's x / aspect) * (screen's x / aspect)) + (screen's z * screen's z))
set vignette to 0.34 + ((1.0 - the smooth transition from 0.57 to 1.33 at edge) * 0.66)
set color's red to the square root of ((color's red * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's red * 0.42)))
set color's green to the square root of ((color's green * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's green * 0.42)))
set color's blue to the square root of ((color's blue * vignette) / (1.0 + (color's blue * 0.42)))
set the fragment color with red color's red, green color's green, blue color's blue and alpha 1.0

scenes.title: Nano Choreography
scenes.source:
# DynLex entrypoint flags: --emit-spirv --shader-stage=fragment

import lib/shader_art.dl

# NANO CHOREOGRAPHY
# A raymarched crystal and motorcycle give way to a model-derived volumetric
# Vitruvian point cloud. Both passes are compiled from this DynLex source.

class:
    patterns:
        planar coordinate
    members:
        x, y

class:
    patterns:
        spatial coordinate
    members:
        x, y, z

class:
    patterns:
        radiant color
    members:
        red, green, blue

class:
    patterns:
        motorcycle motion
    members:
        progress, spin, yaw

class:
    patterns:
        spatial bound
    members:
        center, radius

class:
    patterns:
        ray traversal
    members:
        depth, end, step, active

class:
    patterns:
        surface result
    members:
        hit, position, glow

function a planar coordinate with x {float:x} and y {float:y}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", planar coordinate, x, y)

function a spatial coordinate with x {float:x}, y {float:y} and z {float:z}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", spatial coordinate, x, y, z)

function a radiant color with red {float:red}, green {float:green} and blue {float:blue}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", radiant color, red, green, blue)

function a motorcycle motion at {float:progress} with spin {float:spin} and yaw {float:yaw}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", motorcycle motion, progress, spin, yaw)

function a spatial bound centered at {spatial coordinate:center} with radius {float:radius}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", spatial bound, center, radius)

function a ray traversal from {float:depth} to {float:end}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", ray traversal, depth, end, 0, true)

function an empty surface result at {spatial coordinate:position}:
    replacement:
        @intrinsic("construct", surface result, false, position, 0.0)

function {ray traversal:traversal} continues:
    execute:
        return traversal's active

function {surface result:surface} was hit:
    execute:
        return surface's hit

function the scene window from {float:opening} to {float:closing} at {float:moment}:
    execute:
        set arrival to the smooth transition from opening to (opening + 0.55) at moment
        set departure to 1.0 - the smooth transition from (closing - 0.55) to closing at moment
        return arrival * departure

function the crystal distance at {spatial coordinate:position} rotated by {float:yaw} and {float:pitch}:
    execute:
        set sine to the sine of yaw
        set cosine to the cosine of yaw
        set turned to a spatial coordinate with x ((position's x * cosine) + (position's z * sine)), y position's y and z ((position's z * cosine) - (position's x * sine))
        set sine to the sine of pitch
        set cosine to the cosine of pitch
        set vertical to (turned's y * cosine) - (turned's z * sine)
        set turned's z to (turned's z * cosine) + (turned's y * sine)
        set turned's y to vertical
        set octahedron to ((((the absolute value of (turned's x)) + (the absolute value of (turned's y))) + (the absolute value of (turned's z))) - 1.08) * 0.577
        set core to the ellipsoid distance from (a spatial shader point with x turned's x, y turned's y and z turned's z) with radii (the shader dimensions measuring 0.82 by 1.14 by 0.82)
        return the maximum of octahedron and core
